response.rationale: “Paruh waktu” is ordinary Indonesian and “separuh masa” is ordinary Malaysian Malay for work involving fewer hours than a full schedule. The contrast is useful, though “sambilan” is also used in both varieties.
response.risk_rationale: “Sambilan” may be encountered in both varieties, particularly in the phrase “part-time work.”
response.shared_synonym_rationale: “Sambilan” is a plausible everyday alternative in both varieties, especially in phrases such as “kerja sambilan,” but “paruh waktu” remains a normal Indonesian preference and “separuh masa” a normal Malaysian preference.
